The main takeaway from our work is that
NPY can augment the response of pituitary cells to LHRH to increase LH release by facilitating extracellular Ca2+-influx, possibly through dihydropyride-sensitive voltage-sensitive Ca2+-channels.
NPY enhances LHRH-stimulated LH release by increasing the influx of extracellular Ca(2+), and this action may be mediated by the opening of L-type voltage-sensitive calcium channels.
